source_areas.description: Deprecated repository entry point that routes historical visitors to current Flyto2 product and documentation owners.
Security disclosure policy and durable project memory that keep the repository deprecated and non-authoritative.

feature_surfaces.title: Active repository routing
feature_surfaces.description: Routes users from a retired repository name to the current owners for runtime, cloud, security, indexer, docs, blog, and website work.
verification: Review every external route and confirm that it resolves to a current Flyto2 owner

feature_surfaces.title: Historical release discovery
feature_surfaces.description: Preserves a non-authoritative pointer to historical GitHub Releases without claiming current builds, platforms, or compatibility.

feature_surfaces.title: Security disclosure routing
feature_surfaces.description: Provides a private Flyto2 disclosure channel for issues discovered through legacy artifacts or repository content.
verification: Run the organization documentation audit and verify the flyto2.com security contact domain

feature_surfaces.title: Deprecation guardrail
feature_surfaces.description: Records architectural non-goals and maintenance rules that prevent this shell from becoming an accidental product authority.
verification: Run the organization documentation audit and confirm that no runtime source or package manifest exists
